FN-FKEIW5D-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 233
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/02/2026
Senate Bill 233 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund fines; increase
receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, and other funds to which court costs
are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, the district
attorneys, the Department of Corrections, the Board of Pardons and Paroles, and community
corrections programs by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons
charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
In addition, this bill could increase the obligations of certain municipalities by an undetermined
amount dependent on the cost to reimburse certain county commissions for medical expenses
when an individual is arrested by a municipal law enforcement agency, for offenses pursuant to
this bill, and are detained in a county jail.
